name: Genesis AI
desc: Builds general-purpose robots with its own AI model, Eno robot hardware and a simulation platform.
markets: Factories and warehouses in Europe and the United States, deploying robots for manufacturing and logistics work
talks: Bloomberg reported in July 2026 that the robotics startup was in talks to raise about USD 500M.
talks_outlet: Bloomberg (as cited by The Next Web)
raised_so_far: USD 105M seed (Jul 2025), per The Next Web
status_detail: Announced 17 Nov 2026: USD 500M Series A at USD 3.5B valuation, co-led by Khosla, Premji Invest and Eclipse, with NVentures, AMD Ventures, Bpifrance.
rationale: Freshly funded European physical-AI company courting industrial customers; F1 engineering and automation story fits its brand-building.

name: Foundation Future Industries
desc: Builds humanoid robots for military use, including the Phantom robot, and holds small Pentagon contracts.
markets: US defence and military customers, plus industrial pilots in the United States
talks: CNBC reported the CEO has been trying since at least January to raise hundreds of millions of dollars at a USD 3B valuation; the company is short of cash.
status_detail: No round announced; CNBC (14 Nov 2026) reports missed payroll, a bridge loan from an existing investor in August, and fears of collapse if funding fails.
rationale: Weak fit: cash crisis and governance questions; only a speculative visibility play for a defence humanoid brand.

name: Skylark Labs
desc: Physical AI startup building real-world AI systems used by Indian defence forces and drone maker ideaForge.
markets: Defence and security customers in India, including the Indian Army and Air Force, and the United States
talks: Livemint reported the company is in talks to raise USD 100-150M at a valuation above USD 1B; later reports said about 70% was committed.
raised_so_far: Small seed rounds only; a USD 6M round in Apr 2026 at about USD 250M valuation, per news reports (data sites list USD 2-2.6M total)
status_detail: No announced close found; last reported in late Jul 2026 (Livemint via Entrackr, NewsBytes).
rationale: Defence-focused AI with India-US footprint; limited consumer brand, F1 would be a credibility and recruiting play at most.

name: Irregular
desc: Tests the security of frontier AI models in simulated attack environments for AI labs and governments.
markets: Frontier AI labs such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, plus government clients in the US and Europe
talks: Calcalist (following Globes) reported Irregular is raising more than USD 100M at a USD 1.5B valuation, led by Thrive Capital and Greenoaks; terms not final.
raised_so_far: USD 80M in total across two 2025 rounds (Sequoia, Redpoint), per Calcalist
status_detail: No announcement of a close found; last seen reported 23 Sep 2026 (Calcalist/Globes).
rationale: Profitable AI-security lab selling to top labs and governments; F1 data and cybersecurity partner categories are well established.

name: Emulate (AI lab)
desc: AI research lab founded by former DeepMind researchers building world models that simulate interactive physical environments.
markets: AI research for robotics, simulation, gaming and planning; early stage, customers not disclosed, based in London
talks: FT reported Emulate in advanced talks to raise up to USD 700M in a seed round led by Index Ventures and Lightspeed, with Creandum, at USD 3.7B; Bloomberg said USD 3B before new funds.
talks_outlet: Financial Times / Bloomberg (as cited by The Next Web)
raised_so_far: No prior funding reported; founded Aug 2026, per The Next Web
status_detail: No announcement found; last reported 17 Sep 2026 (FT, Bloomberg, Sifted); firms declined to comment and terms not agreed. One aggregator (KuCoin) called it raised, unverified.
rationale: Well-funded London AI lab recruiting top talent; F1's British engineering base suits world-model simulation storytelling.

name: Discovery Loop
hq: San Francisco Bay Area, United States
desc: AI lab founded by Jeff Dean and Google veterans building AI that proposes and runs scientific experiments autonomously.
markets: AI research for automated science and machine-learning research; no product, customers or launch announced yet
talks: Business Insider reported Discovery Loop in talks to raise USD 1B at about USD 10B (Aug 2026), then talks to raise again at around USD 50B (Sep 2026), citing people familiar.
talks_outlet: Business Insider (as cited by AI Weekly and Dealroom)
raised_so_far: First round led by Radical Ventures and Khosla Ventures (amount not disclosed), with Alphabet as founding investor, per secondary coverage
status_detail: No announced close of the USD 10B or USD 50B round found; last seen reported 12 Sep 2026 (Business Insider via AI Weekly).
rationale: Star-founder lab likely to raise billions and compete for top talent; F1 technology partnerships suit high-profile AI brands.
